title: Automated Assessment System for RPAL Programming
summary: Developed an automated evaluation system for RPAL programming assignments that streamlined assessment of 100+ student projects and reduced grading time by 70%, while providing structured feedback to students.
problem: Manual grading of 100+ RPAL programming assignments was extremely time-consuming for the teaching team. Grading was also inconsistent, and students received minimal actionable feedback on their code.
solution: Built an automated assessment engine that compiles and executes student RPAL programs against a comprehensive test suite, checks for correctness, handles edge cases, and generates structured grading reports with per-student feedback.
achievements: 70% reduction in grading time across 100+ student assignments
Consistent, objective grading eliminating manual inconsistencies
Automated test case execution with comprehensive edge case coverage
Structured per-student feedback reports generated automatically

system.title: Assessment Engine
system.content: The system accepts student submission archives, extracts and compiles RPAL programs, executes them against a hidden test suite spanning normal inputs, edge cases, and error conditions, then computes weighted scores. Grading reports are generated as structured CSV with test-by-test breakdowns and feedback messages per failing case.
